_readme: World of January 1st, 1911 — consumed by game.js's maybeApplyEraOverrides(). Predates every crisis that historically led to WWI: the Agadir Crisis, the Italo-Turkish War, the Xinhai Revolution, and both Balkan Wars haven't happened yet, so this deliberately differs from era_1914.json in exactly the places those events later changed.

entities: new polity codes (or renames of existing codes). name -> countryLookup, color -> map fill, flag -> countryFlagOverrides (relative key under assets/flags/, e.g. 'AUH/1914.png' — see assets/flags/ATTRIBUTION.md for sourcing). AUH/OTT/RUS/DEU/GBR/RAJ/FRA reuse the exact same entities (and flags, where applicable) as era_1914.json, since none of these empires' basic identity changed between 1911 and 1914 — only their territorial extent differs in specific, historically-documented ways (see countryReassignments below). MAR is new here: Morocco is still a nominally independent Sultanate as of Jan 1911, not yet a French protectorate (that's the Agadir Crisis's outcome, per this preset's Simulation Rules).

countryReassignments: keyed by CURRENT EFFECTIVE owner code (so SOML/disputed-territory baseline overrides are honored); every shape owned by the key is reassigned to the value. Differs from era_1914.json in exactly three ways: (1) MAR is NOT reassigned to FRA — Morocco stays its own entity; (2) LBY is reassigned to OTT, not ITA — the Italo-Turkish War (Sept 1911) hasn't happened yet; (3) MKD, XKX, and ALB are reassigned to OTT, not SRB/independent — the Balkan Wars (Oct 1912 - Aug 1913) that historically stripped these from Ottoman control are still over a year away.
regionReassignments: identical to era_1914.json — the Polish partition, Austro-Hungarian Galicia, and Hungarian Transylvania all predate 1911 by well over a century, so nothing here changes.

Known first-pass approximations, deliberately country-level: Alsace-Lorraine stays FRA (modern ADM1 'Grand Est' is far larger than the 1871 territory, and not further subdivided in world_regions.json); North Schleswig stays DNK (same over-breadth problem); South Tyrol/Trentino stays ITA (Italy's world_regions.json only has 5 broad macro-regions, not fine enough to isolate it from Veneto/Friuli); Eupen-Malmedy stays BEL (Belgium's world_regions.json groups the whole country into 3 Gewest/Region-level buckets here — MP1's world_regions.json/custom_geo.json were extended with a real 10-commune Eupen-Malmedy split, see Scripts/mp1_fetch_belgium_subregions.py, but this game's basemap is intentionally left untouched, per this project's standing MP2-stays-intact rule); PNG entirely GBR (NE quarter was German New Guinea); YEM entirely OTT (Aden was British); CHN keeps modern extent (the Qing Dynasty's collapse is a live Simulation Rules event, not a starting-state territorial change); Pacific micro-territories only where a clean single owner exists. Hejaz (Saudi Arabia's Makkah + Al Madinah regions) IS now carved to OTT below, leaving Nejd (the rest of SAU) independent.

Poland does not appear as a country anywhere in this preset: POL is reassigned wholesale to RUS (the Russian partition/'Congress Poland') in countryReassignments, with the German partition (Greater Poland/Posen, West/Pomeranian, Kuyavian-Pomeranian, Warmian-Masurian, Lower Silesian, Opole, Silesian) carved to DEU and the Austrian partition (Lesser Poland, Subcarpathian — Galicia) carved to AUH in regionReassignments.POL.
